name: calendula officinalis flower
purpose: USES Promote rapid healing and helps prevent infection of wounds, skin ulcers and sores.
uses: Directions Wash and dry affected area, apply a thin layer of LMNOOP over affected area, gently massage until fully absorbed, repeat 2-3 times daily.
otcwarn: do not get into eyes Ask doctor if on deep or puncture wounds, animal bites or serious burns. Stop use if condition worsens, symptoms last more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days.
